name: toa-ai
description: Traducteur automatique de mangas/manhwas — monorepo Toa AI

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run backend"
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run setup:backend
